description: Fork of exp082 with B1 weighted-multinomial partition pair sampling for QK and V LUTs. At each LUTBlock, the QK and V TinyMultiHeadLut sampler receives partition_pair_weights so that pairs from the most-recent residual chunk are drawn more often than pairs from older chunks. Weight schedule = 'linear': for L_k>=1 with (k+2) zones, weights = [k+2, k+1, ..., 1] (most-recent block output first, token_emb at the tail). out_proj keeps unweighted H head-partition sampling. All other architecture identical to exp082 (E=O=32, concat-prepend residual, MLP unembedder).
